#| label: setup-brown-results
#| include: false
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, scipen = 999)
project_root <- Sys.getenv("BROWN_ADHERENCE_PROJECT_ROOT")
source(file.path(project_root, "audit/analyses/brown_adherence/main_linkage_b_amendment/stage3/code/report_data.R"))
source(file.path(br_amendment, "stage3/code/report_sensitivities.R"))
main <- br_load_tables()
br_load_sensitivities()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = br_analysis)
br_verify_leaves()
profile_summary <- br_read("table_participant_state_summary", TRUE)
sample_flow <- br_read("table_profile_sample_flow", TRUE)
association_effects <- br_read("table_association_effects", TRUE)
coverage_gate <- br_read("table_coverage_gate", TRUE)
selected_sample <- br_read("table_selected_sample", TRUE)
temporal <- br_read("table_temporal_diagnostic", TRUE)
technical <- br_read("table_technical_disposition", TRUE)
bounded <- br_read("table_bounded_stability", TRUE)
diagnostic_assessment <- br_read("table_diagnostic_assessment", TRUE)
day_groups <- br_read("table_descriptive_wake_cycle_groups", TRUE)
primary_sample <- selected_sample[sample_id == "primary_any_valid"]
support_sample <- selected_sample[sample_id == "support_80"]
within_sleep <- association_effects[association_level == "within" & target_state == "Sleep"]
within_pre_sleep <- association_effects[association_level == "within" & target_state == "Pre-sleep"]
between_sleep <- association_effects[association_level == "between" & target_state == "Sleep"]
between_pre_sleep <- association_effects[association_level == "between" & target_state == "Pre-sleep"]
sample_labels <- c(primary_any_valid = "Any valid period", support_80 = "At least 80% coverage")
calibration_pp <- function(sample) {
  100 * as.numeric(sub(".*: ", "", diagnostic_assessment[sample_id == sample & target == "overall_adherence"]$detail))
}

#| label: tbl-main-samples
#| tbl-cap: "Exact main-analysis samples; windows qualify independently."
br_show("samples")
Six modelled adherence levels with 95% confidence intervals. Free-day adherence is lower for Daytime and Sleep, and higher for Pre-sleep. Colors and point shapes distinguish Work and Free days.

#| label: tbl-main-adherence-levels
#| tbl-cap: "Equal-site recommendation-adherence levels and 95% CIs in both samples."
br_show("levels")

#| label: tbl-main-primary-results
#| tbl-cap: "Free-minus-Work adherence differences by recommendation window."
br_show("primary")

#| label: tbl-main-site-interactions
#| tbl-cap: "Global and window-specific site-by-day-type comparisons."
br_show("interactions")

Three panels show all nine country-coded sites and their Work-day adherence levels. Filled diamonds indicate FDR-supported differences from each window's equal-site mean; open circles do not. The blue reference line is a mean, not the null value of an adherence-level test.

Three panels show all nine site-specific Free-minus-Work estimates per recommendation window. Diamonds compare effects with zero, whereas asterisks compare them with the blue equal-site effect. These two marker meanings must not be interchanged. Bars are 95% confidence intervals.

#| label: tbl-main-compact-adherence
#| tbl-cap: "Work-day adherence, Free-day differences and site-specific deviations from the equal-site average."
br_show("compact")

#| label: tbl-main-endpoint-calibration
#| tbl-cap: "Observed endpoint counts and their stored conditional predictive envelopes."
br_show("endpoints")

Six estimates compare any-valid and at-least-80% coverage samples. Daytime and Sleep retain negative confidence intervals. Pre-sleep remains positive in direction, but its coverage-restricted confidence interval includes zero. Shapes and colors distinguish the samples.

br_show("coverage")

#| label: tbl-selected-samples
#| tbl-cap: "Exact samples used by the selected cross-state models."

selected_sample[, .(
  Sample = sample_labels[sample_id],
  `Outcome rows` = rows,
  Participants = participants,
  `Daytime-anchored cycles` = association_cycles,
  `Participant intercept SD` = sprintf("%.3f", participant_intercept_sd_logit),
  Assessment = gsub("_", " ", fit_status)
)] |>
  gt() |>
  reader_gt() |>
  fmt_integer(columns = c(`Outcome rows`, Participants, `Daytime-anchored cycles`)) |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = c(Sample, Assessment)) |>
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md(
      "The standard deviation is on the conditional logit scale. Both samples retain a participant intercept and the same prespecified adjustment."
    )
  )

Raincloud plot for 139 participants. Sleep adherence is highest, with median 95.2% and interquartile range 80.7% to 99.6%. Daytime is lowest, with median 21.9% and interquartile range 12.2% to 35.5%. Pre-sleep is intermediate and more dispersed, with median 63.8% and interquartile range 43.7% to 84.0%. Each participant has three points connected by a faint gray line. The connections pair the same anonymous participant across recommendation windows and are not time trajectories or rankings.

#| label: tbl-participant-state-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Observed participant-average adherence in the complete three-state display."

profile_summary[, .(
  Window = br_window(state),
  Participants = profiles,
  `Median adherence` = format_percent(median_adherence),
  `Interquartile range` = format_percent_range(
    lower_quartile,
    upper_quartile
  ),
  `Observed range` = format_percent_range(
    minimum_adherence,
    maximum_adherence
  ),
  `Median cycles` = format(median_valid_cycles, trim = TRUE)
)] |>
  gt() |>
  reader_gt() |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = Window) |>
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md(
      "Values are descriptive equal-cycle participant means from the any-valid primary frame."
    )
  )

#| label: tbl-cross-state-effects
#| tbl-cap: "Adjusted Sleep and Pre-sleep differences per 10 percentage points higher Daytime adherence."

effect_display <- association_effects[, .(
  Level = ifelse(
    association_level == "within",
    "Day level, within participant",
    "Overall participant level"
  ),
  Outcome = target_state,
  `Adherence difference (95% CI)` = format_pp_ci(
    response_effect_percentage_points,
    response_conf_low_percentage_points,
    response_conf_high_percentage_points
  ),
  `FDR-adjusted p` = format_p(adjusted_p_value),
  Interpretation = ifelse(
    interval_excludes_zero,
    "Interval excludes zero",
    "Interval includes zero"
  ),
  association_order
)]
setorder(effect_display, association_order)
effect_display[, association_order := NULL]

effect_display |>
  gt(groupname_col = "Level") |>
  reader_gt() |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = c(Outcome, Interpretation)) |>
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md(
      "A false-discovery-rate (FDR) adjustment covered all four displayed effects; the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure is retained in the detailed methods."
    )
  )

#| label: tbl-wake-cycle-groups
#| tbl-cap: "Point-only adjusted target adherence across cohort-relative Daytime-cycle groups."

cycle_group_display <- day_groups[, .(
  Sample = factor(
    sample_labels[sample_id],
    levels = unname(sample_labels)
  ),
  Outcome = factor(target_state, levels = c("Sleep", "Pre-sleep")),
  `Daytime cycle group` = factor(wake_group, levels = c("Low", "Middle", "High")),
  `Daytime cycles` = wake_cycles,
  `Paired outcome periods` = paired_target_periods,
  `Median Daytime deviation` = format_percent(observed_median_wake_deviation),
  `Adjusted outcome adherence` = format_percent(adjusted_target_adherence)
)]
setorder(cycle_group_display, Sample, Outcome, `Daytime cycle group`)

cycle_group_display |>
  gt() |>
  reader_gt() |>
  fmt_integer(columns = c(`Daytime cycles`, `Paired outcome periods`)) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = c(Sample, Outcome, `Daytime cycle group`)
  ) |>
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md(
      "Groups describe within-participant Daytime deviations for cycles. They are not stable participant categories, and no category-level inference was performed."
    )
  )

#| label: tbl-coverage-gate
#| tbl-cap: "Stability after requiring at least 80% coverage within state periods."

coverage_gate[, .(
  Level = ifelse(
    association_level == "within",
    "Day level",
    "Overall participant level"
  ),
  Outcome = target_state,
  `Any-valid effect` = format_pp(primary_response_effect_percentage_points),
  `At least 80% effect` = format_pp(support_80_response_effect_percentage_points),
  `Absolute shift` = format_pp_magnitude(absolute_response_shift_percentage_points),
  Result = ifelse(claim_gate_passed, "Passed", "Did not pass")
)] |>
  gt(groupname_col = "Level") |>
  reader_gt() |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = c(Outcome, Result))
